chapters.reason: The paper explicitly implements a framework that toggles between 'Fast' (System 1) and 'Slow' (System 2) reasoning pathways based on task complexity and confidence.
The framework dynamically scales compute at test-time by choosing between simple inference and more complex, multi-path reasoning processes.
The approach functions as a form of difficulty-adaptive budget allocation, deciding whether to use a short or long reasoning chain to optimize efficiency.
